highlight.note: Before each AI call its worst case is held against every cap and the balance; it is settled at the reply's real cost.

highlight.text: What you were not charged for
highlight.note: A repair of an employee's own mistake is recorded, and not billed.
Hosting is counted from use after the fact, at the hosting rates, and never refused.
As the build works, AI work rises here — and in the budget bars, each employee's cost, the app's cost this month and the operator's balances.
An app's own AI calls also stop at its monthly allowance.
